author: prime_restart
historical_disposition: prior justification found on narrower hypotheses; new generalization supplied
lean_disposition: unchanged; no build or new theorem

obligations.required_input: Positive-modulus generalized CRT and elementary finite LCM arithmetic.
obligations.constructed_input: A=Pi^3*Mminus, B=Mplus, and the three literal residues zero, one, h0 over positive moduli.
obligations.justification: README sections 1-2 prove both directions directly; the executable is not the proof.

obligations.required_input: Every positive Pi,L and nonnegative h0; every nonempty finite family of positive paired orders.
obligations.constructed_input: Every nonempty finite positive paired-order family is accepted, with positive Pi and L and nonnegative h0 fixed as input.
obligations.justification: No order-distribution or pattern-existence quantifier is introduced. Fixed class analytic thresholds stay separate.

obligations.required_input: The intended family is exactly Fin3 x Fin5 at common Clearing, Values and Roots.
obligations.constructed_input: All occurrences of the original Fin3 x Fin5 family are retained when supplied; the recorded concrete four-prime sample remains a distinct Fin4 example.
obligations.justification: The executable accepts all occurrences without deduplicating. Four-prime and synthetic inputs are labelled separate examples.

obligations.required_input: All 15 positions and both members, including internal and cross-neighbor gcd obstructions.
obligations.constructed_input: A graph vertex for both orders at each supplied position, partner edges, and all pairwise nontrivial-gcd edges.
obligations.justification: All distinct occurrence pairs receive nontrivial-gcd equality edges and each position receives an opposite edge.

obligations.required_input: Original root swap bits transport actual primary/opposite orders to minus/plus LCMs.
obligations.constructed_input: The original root-swap bit at a_i maps to minus versus plus exactly as in ActualRootSwapOrders318; finite-field calculations use R=(1+r,2r) and D=(3-r)^2.
obligations.justification: ActualRootSwapOrders318 is the source identity. Finite-field roots are explicit and not identified with arbitrary p-adic choices.

obligations.required_input: Positive orders/moduli, nonempty index family, unit orders, h0=0, and non-squarefree factors.
obligations.constructed_input: The API rejects empty families and zero/nonpositive moduli or orders; unit orders and h0=0 are retained.
obligations.justification: Zero moduli and empty families are rejected; integer h0-1 avoids truncated natural subtraction. Tests include unit orders and all assignments.

obligations.required_input: The CRT residues are exactly h=0 mod Pi^3*Mminus, h=1 mod Mplus, h=h0 mod L.
obligations.constructed_input: A=Pi^3*lcm(minus orders) and B=lcm(plus orders), with explicit merged CRT residue and period.
obligations.justification: README 1 and exact_crt retain exponent3 and all three residues. Supplied order bounds cannot be substituted for exact orders to claim completeness.

obligations.required_input: No existing manuscript or Lean consumer is altered.
obligations.constructed_input: A standalone research packet and candidate future adapter; all existing manuscript and Lean consumers remain unchanged.
obligations.justification: The broadened predicate and native formal-quotient bridge are pending; old Extra/Compatible remains sufficient, not relabelled exact.

obligations.required_input: Finite diagnostics, exact reduction certificates, written elementary proof, and Lean acceptance are distinct.
obligations.constructed_input: Written elementary proof, source bindings, brute-force finite tests, affine certificates, and a separately implemented Jacobian verifier.
obligations.justification: No Lean build ran; no new native theorem, fifteen-prime witness, real-orbit hit, or growing-screen density is asserted.
